name: Jamil Sayegh
reason: His own offers are sold on physical conditions: the Healing Sanctuary page lists clients' tumours shrinking, autoimmune symptoms and chronic pain going, the speaker page claims cancerous tumours shrank and strokes and aneurysms resolved, and the Phoenix Field page carries a breast-cancer testimonial about declining treatment, so almost nothing passes the health-claim rule (his book is print-on-demand, not on Amazon); the Kripalu forgiveness weekend (19–21 Mar 2027) alone is too thin.
